# Ethisyn

> Build. Automate. Grow. Create. | Technology, AI and digital growth for ambitious businesses.
> Independent Digital Product Engineering & Autonomous AI Systems Studio in Hyderabad.

- Core Pillars: BUILD • AUTOMATE • GROW • CREATE
- [Website](https://ethisyn.in): Official digital studio home
- Headquarters: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Founded: 2022
- Direct Inquiries: hello@ethisyn.in
- Studio Model: Founding Domain Partners directing client systems with 100% in-house engineering and craft.
- [Full Knowledge Corpus](https://ethisyn.in/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical specifications and FAQ

## Navigation & Official Site Structure
- [Services](https://ethisyn.in/#services): Engineering, AI automation, growth, and design services
- [Products](https://ethisyn.in/#products): Proprietary software applications (The Rental Circle, GoWider)
- [Team](https://ethisyn.in/team): 11 founding domain leads and technical partners
- [Blog](https://ethisyn.in/blog): Engineering perspectives, AI architecture, and systems dispatches
- [Careers](https://ethisyn.in/careers): Founding engineering, AI, and design career opportunities
- [Contact](https://ethisyn.in/#contact): Direct technical scoping and project onboarding

## Core Studio Pillars (BUILD • AUTOMATE • GROW • CREATE)
- [BUILD: Software & Digital Product Development](https://ethisyn.in/#services): Business websites, web applications, mobile applications, SaaS products, custom business software, CRM systems, admin & management portals, and backend architectures.
- [AUTOMATE: AI & Business Automation](https://ethisyn.in/#services): AI agents, AI voice agents, AI chatbots, workflow automation, business process automation, CRM automation, document intelligence, and lead management systems.
- [GROW: Digital Marketing & Growth](https://ethisyn.in/#services): Search engine optimization (SEO), local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media management, content marketing, and high-intent customer acquisition.
- [CREATE: Creative & Content](https://ethisyn.in/#services): Video production, videography, video editing, social media content, promotional videos, brand promotions, and marketing creatives.

## Proprietary Software Products
- [The Rental Circle](https://therentalcircle.in): Peer-to-peer verified equipment and lifestyle rental marketplace with secure escrow settlements, KYC verification, and dynamic rental management.
- [GoWider](https://ethisyn.in/#products): All-in-one restaurant operations platform integrating POS billing, live kitchen display systems (KDS), QR table ordering, and inventory depletion.

## Studio Commitments
- 100% In-House: Zero outsourcing to mystery freelancers; clients collaborate directly with founding partners.
- Sub-Second Performance: Verified on real mobile devices under high network constraints.
- Response SLA: Inquiries triaged and answered within 4 business hours.
- Strict Privacy: Zero street/door number disclosures; established in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
